notes.title: New version - fixes start-up crashes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just activated a new version which solves the start-up crashes reported by sever players. Thanks go to everyone who has submitted a crash report, they have been very helpful. Also having controllers connected to the machine should be fine now.

On a site note we are working on an offline mode for the game which will include everything: progression, loot drops and tank assembly. It will take at least one more week but we will start rolling it over the beta channel as soon as it's reasonably stable.

Cheers
